meta.title: Telegram
meta.description: Link Telegram to Bronevik: stats, sessions and marks in the bot, notifications and the mini app.

toast.codeFailed: Could not get a code, try again
toast.linked: Link established — the bot is online

hero.title: HQ <hot>in your pocket</hot>
hero.lead: Link Telegram and the bot will ping you about a new mark, a session recap or a threshold drop. Stats on command, no site visit needed.

request.title: Get on the radio
request.description: Get a one-time code and send it to the bot — your account links automatically. The bot never needs your Lesta password or data.

steps.send: Tap Start or send the command with the code
steps.done: This page notices the link by itself

request.note: The code is single-use and lives for a few minutes. Do not forward it to anyone.

ticket.label: Cipher for the bot
ticket.fallback: Button did not work? Send the bot this command

linked.description: The bot knows who you are: commands answer for your primary account and notifications land here.

unlink.title: Unlink Telegram?
unlink.description: The bot will stop sending notifications and recognising you. You can link it again at any time.

commands.title: Bot commands

list.me: your stats: WN8, win rate, damage
list.session: the current session — how the evening is going
list.marks: marks of excellence and the damage to the next one

commands.inline: inline mode: mention the bot and a nickname in any chat

miniApp.title: Bronevik inside Telegram
miniApp.description: Stats, session and marks in one tap — right from the bot chat, no browser needed.

meta.title: Sign in with Telegram
meta.description: Sign in to Bronevik with a one-time link from the bot.

missing.title: No sign-in code
missing.description: This page opens from a link the bot sends. Send the bot {command} and it will send a fresh one.

invalid.title: Broken link
invalid.description: The code in the link does not look right — it may have been cut off when copied. Ask the bot for a new link with {command}.

redeeming.title: Checking your pass
redeeming.description: Verifying the code with the bot, this takes a second.

failed.title: This link no longer works
failed.description: The code has expired or was already used. Ask the bot for a new link with {command}.

success.title: You are in
success.description: Signed in, taking you to your account.

meta.title: Mini app
meta.description: Bronevik in Telegram: stats, your last session and marks in one tap.

outside.title: Open in Telegram
outside.description: This page is the Bronevik mini app. Open it from {bot} and it will recognise your account.

failed.title: Could not sign you in
failed.description: Telegram did not confirm the sign-in. Try again or link Telegram in your account on the site.

preview.text: Preview: this is how Bronevik looks inside Telegram

noAccount.title: No Lesta account linked
noAccount.description: Link your game account with Lesta ID on the site and your stats will show up here.

session.empty: No sessions yet — play a couple of battles and the recap shows up here.

marks.title: Closest to a mark
marks.empty: No mark progress yet — install the companion mod to see percentages.
